title: DelegatedPrincipalCredential — C2 DPC profile (DESIGN.md §14.4, §16.3; family contract L5–L6, R39/R40)
description: The short-lived delegated-principal credential the Kovee gateway presents for kovee_endeavor_form and external_command_terminalize. DESIGN.md §16 names the record but carries no field list (recorded gap — C2 slice 1 gap notes); this profile transcribes §14.4's two normative sentences: a sender-constrained credential binds token id, proof key (mTLS or DPoP-style, or a local channel-exporter binding), Participant and binding epoch, endpoint incarnation, recovery epoch, audience, surface, operation family, exact subject or preparation scope, nonce, issue time, and short expiry; and a Kovee gateway delegation binds principal, Society, operation family, exact prepared subject or preparation scope, authentication observation, assurance level, audience, nonce, issue time, and short expiry. A generic Kovee service credential cannot become a principal (§14.4).

nonce.description: Single-use: the (issuer_ref, nonce) pair is atomic — a replay under the same pair returns the stored result, never a second execution (family contract L5–L6; UNIQUE enforced in code).

method.description: Closed §14.4 list: mTLS or DPoP-style proof key, or a local channel-exporter binding.

sender_constraint.description: Sender-constrained, not merely bearer and audience-bound (§14.4).

source_actor_binding_digest.description: The durable source-principal binding; EndeavorFormationIntent/Slot and the terminalize same-source-human check pin exactly this digest (§16.3).

bound_participant_ref.description: The already admitted human Participant the principal acts for (R39: never manufactured membership).

audience.description: Must equal the pinned KoveeRealmByomBinding.delegated_principal_audience (enforced in code).

surface.description: R39/R40 are governance-surface rows; no other surface accepts this credential.

allowed_operations.description: Closed operation family: the two delegated-principal operations (family contract R39/R40); the read-only query rides the R42 recovery workload, never this credential.

delegated_principal_subject_digest.description: Exact prepared subject or preparation scope (§14.4); EndeavorFormationIntent pins the same digest.

expires_at.description: Short expiry (§14.4); the per-attempt proof envelope is replaced on retry while the semantic command bytes stay fixed (§16.3).

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z offset. DESIGN.md does not fix a timestamp wire encoding; this derivation freezes with the bundle (gap note G3).

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.
